Copy for LLM adds Finder Quick Actions that turn selected files or folders into structured context: a directory tree followed by filtered file contents.

The optional preview window provides filters and a live token estimate. PDFs, Office documents, and screenshots can be converted into text locally on the Mac, without uploading them to an external service.

## What it is for

- Copy a project without including build output, virtual environments, or secrets.
- Preview and reduce large selections before pasting.
- Copy only a directory tree or a set of paths when full contents are unnecessary.
